subject: Newsletter topic activity as an intent input
body:
6sense's documented inputs are research and review-site intent, web deanonymisation and first-party engagement, complemented by partners including Bombora, TechTarget, TrustRadius and G2. I could not find a public statement either way on newsletter content.

NewsletterFIT reads a corpus of newsletters and extracts companies, people, topics, guests and sponsors from each issue, with repeated snapshots of publication activity. The question is whether newsletter topic activity adds predictive context on top of the intent you already buy.

If it is worth a test, I can send a matched sample against accounts you already score. If your partner feeds already cover it, one line closes the loop.
